content: Isra7eele asaas yayyida gisho, Iyaarko katama gimbe dirsaa pengeti gordetidosona. Oonika katamaa gelanawunne keyanaw danda7enna.
Goday Iyyasuko, “Iyaarko katamaa iya kawaranne iya mino olanchotara ne kushen aatha immas.
Neeranne ne olanchotara salpidi, gallasan issi toho usupun gallas gakanaw, katamaa gimbe dirsaa yuushuwa yuuyite.
Laapun kahineti issoy issoy moyze oykidi, Godaa caaqo taabotiya sinthan boo. Laapuntha gallas kahineti moyze punniya wode hinte katamaa laapun toho yuuyite.
Kahineti moyze goochidi punuwa hinte si7iya wode, asa ubbay ellesidi banta qaala dhoqu oothidi waasso. Hessafe guye, katamaa gimbe dirsay kundana. He wode asa ubbay gido lawuhu gidi gelana” yaagis.
Nawe na7a Iyyasu kahineta xeegidi, “Godaa caaqo taabotiya tookite. Hintefe laapun kahineti moyze oykidi, caaqo taabotiyape sinthe aadhidi boo” yaagis.
Asaako qassi, “Bidi, katamaa yuushuwan yuuyite; olanchoti Godaa caaqo taabotiya sinthan hemetonna” yaagidi kiittis.
Iyyasuy odidaysada, laapun kahineti laapun moyze punnishe Godaa sinthan hemetidosona; qassi Godaa caaqo taabotey enta kaallis.
Olas dancidaysati moyze punniya kahineta sinthan hemetoosona. Kahineti qanxonna moyze punniya wode derey taabotiyape guyera kaallees.
Shin Iyyasuy, “Ta hintena waasso goonnashin waassofite woyko hinte qaala sissofite; hari attoshin issi qaalaka odetofite. Ta hintena waasso giya he gallas waassite” yaagidi asaa kiittis.
Hessa gisho, Godaa caaqo taabotey he katamaa issi toho yuuyanaada oothis. Yaatidi asay banta dunkaanida guta simmidi, yan aqidosona.
Wontetha gallas Iyyasuy guuridi dendis; kahinetika Godaa caaqo taabotiya tookidosona.

Laapun moyzeta oykida laapun kahineti banta moyziya qanxonna punnishe caaqo taabotiya sinthan boosona. Moyzey qanxonna punetiya wode olanchoti kahinetape sinthan qassi derey taabotiyape guyera kaallees.
Nam7antho gallas katamaa issi toho yuuyidi, banta dunkaanida guta simmidosona. Usupun gallas gakanaw hessada oothidosona.
Laapuntha gallas gontey wadhishin dendidi, kaseysada katama laapun toho yuuyidosona. He gallasa xalaala katamaa laapun toho enti yuuyidosona.
Laapuntha yuushuwan, kahineti moyze punniya wode, Iyyasuy asaako, “Goday ha katamaa hintew aathidi immida gisho, waassite” yaagidi kiittis.

“Katamaynne iya giddon de7iyaba ubbay Godaas qangetidaba gididi dhayanaw bessees. Nuuni biitta xomoosana mela yeddida asata qosada ashshida, laymiya Raabanne I son de7iya asaa xalaali attanaw bessees.
Shin hinte metonne qoho Isra7eele guta bolla ehona mela dhayanaw bessiyabape aybaka amotidi ekonnaada hinte huuphes naagetite.
Biraynne worqey, naase biratape oosetida miisheti ubbay, Godaas dummatidaba gido. Enti Godaa miishiya minjiya shaaliyan de7o” yaagis.
Hessa gisho, moyzey punetis; asay waassis. Derey moyze punuwa si7ida wode banta qaala dhoqu oothi waassin, katamaa gimbiya dirsay kundis. He saaten asay lawuhu gidi gelidi katamaa oykidosona.
Banta mashsha denthidi, macca adde, na7a cima, mehe, dorse, harenne kataman shempora de7iyaba ubbaa wodhidosona.
Iyyasuy biitta xomoosanaw kiitetida nam7u asatako, “Layme Raabi soo bidi, kase hinte iw caaqidaysada, iyonne I soo asa ubbaa kessite” yaagis.
Enti bidi, Raabo, I aawa, I aayiw, I ishatanne I dabbota ubbaa Isra7eele asay dunkaanida gutaape gaxa kessidi wothidosona.
Yaati simmidi katamaanne iya giddon de7iyaba ubbaa xuuggidosona. Shin biranne worqaa, naase biratape oosetida miisheta Godaa miishiya minjiya shaaliyan wothidosona.

Shin laymiya Raaba Iyaarko xomoosana mela kiitetida asata qosada ashshida gisho, Iyyasuy iyo, I aawa soo asaanne iira de7iya dabbota ubbaa hayqope ashshis. I kochati hachi gakanaw Isra7eele biittan de7oosona.
He wode Iyyasuy,

content.text: Buroo baasiya wode iya bayra na7ay hayqo,
Pengiya aathiya wode iya tesho na7ay hayqo”

content: yaagidi baaddis.
Goday Iyyasura gidida gisho, iya sunthay biitta ubbaa gakis.
